usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all PDM views the authenticated user can access; no parameters are required and any valid API token is sufficient since access is user-scoped by the server. Views define named resource filters (include/exclude rules by type, pool, tag, remote, or resource ID) that scope what resources are visible in the PDM UI or downstream calls — fetch this list before referencing a view ID in other operations. The 'layout' field is an opaque JSON string intended for UI state and can be ignored in automation contexts.

examples.summary: List all views available to the current API token user

tips: No query parameters exist — the response scope is determined entirely by the authenticated user's permissions.
Each view's 'id' is the handle used to reference that view in other config or resource-scoping operations.
Filter rules support an optional 'exact:' prefix to force exact matching rather than substring matching on pool/tag/remote names.
A view with 'include-all: true' and no exclude rules returns every resource the user can see — effectively an unfiltered view.
The 'layout' field is opaque UI state; skip it in automation and only parse 'include', 'exclude', and 'include-all' for resource scoping logic.
